reasons: Both drafts render a creeping, channel-first flood, tie full moon to spring tides correctly, and flag Lindisfarne specifics for checking. B adds more guidance a harbour master would probe: why she is out there at all (published safe-crossing windows, leaving late), the galloping-horse myth, the choice between road and Pilgrims' Way, and daily tide shifts for consistency across the rest of the story. A is equally sound and slightly more restrained with numbers, but covers less of what keeps the wider story plausible.
